name: datacharter
description: Local-first, contract-governed data explorer with read-only, PII-masked query tools for AI agents.
long_description: DataCharter lets a model query your own data — local files (CSV, Parquet, Excel) and databases (SQLite, DuckDB, Postgres) federated through DuckDB — while a YAML "charter" governs access. The agent only ever sees four read-only tools (list_sources, list_tables, describe_table, query), with automatic PII masking, read-only enforcement, and row-level security applied server-side. It runs entirely on your machine; no data leaves your control except to the sources you configure. Point it at a workspace folder that contains a charter.yaml.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List configured data sources with their types.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all queryable tables with their fully-qualified relation names.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Show columns and types for one relation (e.g. 'crm.customers').

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run a read-only, PII-masked SQL query and return rows.

workspace.title: Workspace directory
workspace.description: Folder containing your charter.yaml (and data). DataCharter serves only the sources declared there.
